on_battle_start: The winds of the Valkyrie Dungeon favor the bold. Do you dare challenge me?
Feel the silver skies descend. This is Aether's trial.
on_battle_won: The winds do not carry the unworthy. Train harder and return.
Silence falls over the dungeon. You are not ready yet.
on_battle_lost: The sky bows to you, challenger. Take this badge and soar.
Impressive. Few have matched the Aether's fury.
